## Agent 2 — Data Write

Trigger: ElevenLabs **post-call** webhook.
Action: map transcript/outcome → POST to the CRM `/api/calls`.

### Before activating
1. Copy this node's Production webhook URL into your ElevenLabs agent's
   **post-call webhook** setting.
2. In **POST to CRM**, set the URL to `https://<your-crm>/api/calls` and the
   `x-webhook-secret` header to your CRM `WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
3. For richer outcomes, configure the ElevenLabs agent to **collect** data
   points named `outcome` (confirmed|no_answer|rescheduled|not_interested)
   and `sentiment` (positive|neutral|negative); the Map node reads them.

(Alternatively skip Agent 2 and point ElevenLabs straight at
`/api/webhooks/call-completed`, which verifies the ElevenLabs signature.)
